criteria.requirement: Implement dpath.keymerge.merge_by_key(left,right,key). Materialize and validate both record iterables before merging: every mapping has a hashable business key and no duplicates within a side, using (type,value) identity so bool/int/string keys are not silently conflated. Preserve left order, recursively merge matching dictionary fields with right scalar/list replacement, append new records in right order, and deep-copy all retained/incoming nodes. Reject malformed/duplicate/unhashable keys without mutating either input. Do not change default dpath.merge list concatenation or original source references.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
